questions.explanation: Haggai 2:3 (ESV): "Is it not as nothing in your eyes?"

questions.explanation: Haggai 2:4 (ESV): "Work, for I am with you, declares the Lord of hosts,"

questions.explanation: Haggai 2:5 (ESV): "My Spirit remains in your midst. Fear not."

questions.explanation: Haggai 2:6 (ESV): "I will shake the heavens and the earth and the sea and the dry land."

questions.explanation: Haggai 2:7 (ESV): "and I will fill this house with glory, says the Lord of hosts."

questions.explanation: Haggai 2:8 (ESV): "The silver is mine, and the gold is mine, declares the Lord of hosts."

questions.explanation: Haggai 2:9 (ESV): "And in this place I will give peace, declares the Lord of hosts."

questions.question: If someone carries holy meat in the fold of his garment and touches with his fold bread or pottage or wine or oil or any kind of food, does it become holy? The priests answered and said...
Then Haggai said, "If someone who is unclean by contact with a dead body touches any of these, does it become unclean?" The priests answered and said...
questions.explanation: Haggai 2:13 (ESV): "The priests answered and said, 'It does become unclean.'"

questions.explanation: Haggai 2:14 (ESV): "And what they offer there is unclean."

questions.question: Pray, now, consider what will come to pass from this day onward. Before a stone was placed upon a stone in the temple of the Lord, how did you fare? When one came to a heap of twenty measures, there were but...
questions.explanation: Haggai 2:16 (ESV): "When one came to a heap of twenty measures, there were but ten."

questions.question: I struck you and all the products of your toil with blight and with mildew and with hail, yet you did not turn to me, declares the Lord. Consider from this day onward, from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month. Since the day that the foundation of the Lord's temple was laid, consider: Is the seed yet in the barn? Indeed, the vine, the fig tree, the pomegranate, and the olive tree have yielded nothing. But from this day on I will...
questions.explanation: Haggai 2:19 (ESV): "But from this day on I will bless you."

key_verse_text: The latter glory of this house shall be greater than the former, says the Lord of hosts. And in this place I will give peace, declares the Lord of hosts.
